findings.title: Reentrancy in withdraw: ETH sent before the balance is reset
findings.description: withdraw() sends ETH with call before setting balances[msg.sender] to 0.
findings.exploitScenario: An attacker contract re-enters withdraw() from receive() and drains the vault.
findings.suggestedFix: Reset the balance before the external call (checks-effects-interactions) or use a reentrancy guard.
